يصطحب (form VIII)
# يَصْطَحِبُ (yaṣṭaḥibu) /jasˤ.tˤa.ħi.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِصْطَحَبَ (iṣṭaḥaba)
# يُصْطَحَبُ (yuṣṭaḥabu) /jusˤ.tˤa.ħa.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِصْطَحَبَ (iṣṭaḥaba)
# يَصْطَحِبَ (yaṣṭaḥiba) /jasˤ.tˤa.ħi.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَحَبَ (iṣṭaḥaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
